text: I understand your frustration, and I want to help you resolve this issue. Since you're unable to provide the standard authentication methods (email or name + zip code) and this is urgent, I'll transfer you to a human agent who may have additional options to assist you.
zh: 我理解您的沮丧，我想帮助你解决这个问题的。由于您无法提供标准的身份验证方法（电子邮件或姓名+邮政编码），并且这很紧急，我会将您转接到一个人类代理，他可能有额外的选项来帮助您。
